messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

A related product, gabapentin enacarbil (Horizant), is approved for moderate to severe restless legs syndrome in adults.
The approved uses depend on the specific product.
No single gabapentin product is approved for all of these conditions.
See the table below for a breakdown by brand.

The relation 'fda approved to treat' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is approved by the FDA for the treatment of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is approved for': The subject drug has received FDA approval for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
D. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
